newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 4.8 bln lvs 9-day discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 4.8 bln lvs 9-day discount T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Friday placed another special issue of nine-day discount T-bills, the fourth one in the last three days, yielding 4.06 percent until maturity, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The ministry has recently said it planned to meet treasury paper payments with rollover issues of government securities after domestic debt rose by 171 billion levs to 839.3 billion levs in November.
Finance ministry officials were not available for comment.
In line with its usual practice the BNB did not say with which financial institution or institutions the issue was placed.
The ministry had to meet on Friday some 4.6 billion levs of interest and maturity payments on a 16-day floater coupon T-bill issue, BNB figures showed.
On Wednesday and Thursday the ministry placed three special issues of nine-day discount T-bills with a total par of 20.284 billion levs, all yielding 4.06 percent until maturity.
Interest and maturity payments on government securities due on Wednesday and Thursday totalled some 21.6 billion levs, figures showed.
